mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above the 2017 base (100) indicates a healthy manufacturing sector, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
